requests.text: Initialize moldea for Cinder Returns, a small assistant using Vercel AI SDK that looks up fictional order records and drafts structured return recommendations for staff. Our return window is 30 elapsed 24-hour days from delivery, including the exact boundary. Missing delivery facts stay unknown, and staff approve every decision. Start with a small proposal; hold off on implementing the assistant. Use @moldea.ai/cli@13.0.0 for setup.
requests.observedResult: Explicit initialization and proposal only; CLI13 adoption,0 canonical agents and no assistant implementation. Validation0errors/warnings and integration smoke passed; runtime versions pinned.

requests.text: Implement the proposal now. Use one real AI SDK ToolLoopAgent, one read-only order lookup and Output.object for structured staff recommendations. Keep the deterministic elapsed-time assessment, grounded order identifiers, missing facts and required human staff approval explicit in the result; the assistant cannot issue refunds, create returns or change orders. Inspect the installed ai@7.0.148 APIs before wiring it. Provide npm test and npm run typecheck; tests should exercise the actual agent loop, lookup and structured parsing with MockLanguageModelV4 only at the external model boundary, without provider credentials or live calls. Include exact30-day and one-millisecond-over boundaries using supplied UTC timestamps. Update the directly affected usage documentation.

requests.text: Show how staff should read the uncertain cases. Run CR-102 (missing delivery), CR-999 (unknown identifier), and a temporarily unavailable order lookup through the actual assistant path at 2026-10-15T12:00:00.000Z using the controlled model boundary. Show the structured results and explain the difference between missing facts, no matching record and a failed lookup; none should become an eligibility decision. Keep source order data read-only, retain pending staff approval, and add a short usage note only if that distinction is missing from the README.
